title: Deep Frequency Filtering for Domain Generalization
mechanism: FFT of intermediate feature maps with a learned spatial attention mask over frequencies that keeps transferable components and damps the rest.
adaptation: Insert DFF at layer2 and layer3 of ResNet-34, train with source-balanced batches over the 5 sources, and score on E1.
min_experiment: Arm: house + DFF, 5 seeds. Baseline: house. Metric: E1 crack relF1@2. Kill: < +0.02.
evidence: R: beats prior SOTA on closed-set classification and open-set retrieval domain generalisation (abstract).
